import json, hashlib
P = 'data/cache/df959d743e53206f56db2f92.docs.json'
C = 'loop/state/out/read_xiyou_L0_0028.candidate.json'
S, E = 193063, 199463
EXPECT = 'c282cf39b2ae739a15a3efe4a0e83af546c525bcaad3bac6e21c9d6179a152a2'
raw = open(P, 'rb').read()
fh = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
T = json.loads(raw)[0]['text']
doc = json.load(open(C, encoding='utf-8'))
def walk(o, out):
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        if 'quote' in o and isinstance(o.get('start'), int) and isinstance(o.get('end'), int):
            out.append(o)
        for v in o.values():
            walk(v, out)
    elif isinstance(o, list):
        for v in o:
            walk(v, out)
nodes = []
walk(doc, nodes)
bad = 0
for n in nodes:
    a, b, q = n['start'], n['end'], n['quote']
    if not (S <= a < b <= E) or T[a:b] != q or T.count(q) != 1:
        bad += 1
anchors = [x['range'] for x in doc['sceneAnchors']]
gaps = [anchors[i+1][0] - anchors[i][1] for i in range(len(anchors)-1) if anchors[i+1][0] > anchors[i][1]]
paras, pos = [], 0
for line in T[S:E].split('\n'):
    if line.strip():
        paras.append((S+pos, S+pos+len(line)))
    pos += len(line) + 1
uncov = [i+1 for i, (a, b) in enumerate(paras)
         if not any(a < n['end'] and n['start'] < b for n in nodes)]
print('fileHash=%s...%s' % (fh[:8], fh[-6:]))
print('nodes=%d distinct=%d bad=%d' % (len(nodes), len({n['quote'] for n in nodes}), bad))
print('anchorGaps=%d max=%d' % (len(gaps), max(gaps) if gaps else 0))
print('uncoveredParagraphs=%d %s' % (len(uncov), uncov))
print('OK' if (bad == 0 and not gaps and not uncov and fh == EXPECT) else 'MISMATCH')
